dog.description_text:
Hi, I’m Jeremy! I’m the biggest snuggle bug. I love to be around my human. I’ll cuddle by your feet while you work and chew on my toys. My favorite is curling up on your lap and getting pets and belly rubs.

I’m a smart pup and am highly food motivated. I’ve already learned “sit,” “lay down,” “come,” “fetch,” and am working on “stay” and “place.” I’m house trained to pee and poo on the pad and crate trained as well.

I have a curious personality. I love exploring my physical space and smelling all the smells. I’m not allowed to walk outside yet but I enjoy being carried around the city and people watching. I’ve ridden the subway and do well in a care, too. My foster mom thinks I’m a silly goose, because I like to be carried on my back and will fall asleep in your arms. Once I can walk outside, I’ll love playing fetch!

I’m a social butterfly and warm up quickly to people. I’ll take pets from everyone and give affection and kisses back. I also love playing with my sister. We wrestle and tug over toys all day. I occupy myself by chewing on bones and solving treat puzzles.

I can’t wait to meet my forever family!

﻿Jeremy is approximately 0y 2m 18d old and may be 45 to 55 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
